verdict.rationale: Ollama has a hosted cloud tier: you can run larger models on Ollama's Cloud and call cloud models with an API key. A pricing page exists, and its one cited line says you can run multiple models concurrently. Marketing copy also mentions "more usage" and "dedicated capacity", but nothing in the pack spells out actual tier names, prices, rate limits, or usage caps. Missing for 10: concrete pricing tiers and prices, documented rate limits, explicit usage caps or quotas per tier, independent corroboration of cloud limits.
